questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: At 00:07-00:10, the board is fully visible and holds exactly three pens in a row.
The middle pen is oriented with its tip pointing down, while the left and right pens have their caps pointing down. They are not all aligned identically.
All three pens appear to have black/dark grey barrels and components.
The middle pen shows a bare writing tip pointing downwards, whereas the outer two pens show capped ends pointing downwards. This indicates a missing cap or wrong orientation.
The board moves smoothly from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their relative positions on the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The middle pen is flipped upside down relative to the other two pens (tip pointing down vs caps pointing down), which constitutes a wrong orientation anomaly.
